entries.DesertFestival_Abigail: I'm glad you fixed up the bus! This is really fun.$h#$e#I've always wanted to travel beyond Pelican Town.
entries.DesertFestival_Abigail_marriage: I was thinking of joining you in the skull caves, but then I saw the food stand...#$e#You go on ahead without me... just be careful!
entries.DesertFestival_Alex: Have you seen the size of these Calico Eggs?#$b#Just imagine the protein...
entries.DesertFestival_Alex_marriage: Hey... you look really cute in the desert sun...$h
entries.DesertFestival_Caroline: This weather is just perfect. I can't tell where my skin ends and the air begins.$h
entries.DesertFestival_Clint: Hey, @. To tell you the truth, I don't really like festivals.#$b#But I'd feel even worse if I stayed at home, knowing that everyone else was out here having fun.$s
entries.DesertFestival_Demetrius: Why do humans enjoy spicy food? It's counter-intuitive from a biological perspective.#$e#Unless there's something I'm missing...$5
entries.DesertFestival_Elliott: *mumble* ...hmm, the toe-feel is milky, but with plenty of body. Still, a bit mellower than back home...#$b#Oh, pardon me! I've become something of a sand connoisseur.$h
entries.DesertFestival_Elliott_marriage: Well well well, what have we here? A beautiful desert rose!$h#$e#Make sure to stay watered, dear.
entries.DesertFestival_Emily: Hmm... I'm sensing that your fashion doesn't quite match your inner feeling. Just step in the box and we'll fix you up!
entries.DesertFestival_Emily2_marriage: I've been having fun, but I'm so busy I haven't been able to do any chores at home. I hope you're doing okay!
entries.DesertFestival_Emily3_marriage: I can't remember... did I feed the parrot this morning?
entries.DesertFestival_Emily_marriage: Hey, @! I love you just the way you are... but if you want, you can step inside the box too!
entries.DesertFestival_Evelyn: Ah... the sands of time, the sands of time...
entries.DesertFestival_George: What is she mumbling about? I'm here for the spicy food tent!
entries.DesertFestival_Gus: Normally I provide all the food for town festivals. But not today! It's nice to be able to relax.$h
entries.DesertFestival_Haley: If you smell something good, it's the coconut oil I rubbed all over my skin.#$b#I'm going 'all in' with the desert feeling!$h
entries.DesertFestival_Haley_marriage: Hey... looks like someone's got a nice tan going... *pinch*$h
entries.DesertFestival_Harvey: Going into the caves can be really dangerous. I hope there are no accidents, but still... I'll be here all day just in case.#$e#As a doctor, I'd recommend minimizing your exposure to serpent-infested caverns! But ultimately, it's your choice.
entries.DesertFestival_Harvey_marriage: Hey, @. I'll be working late during the festival, so don't wait up for me at night!#$e#Promise me you'll be careful in the skull caves.
entries.DesertFestival_Jas: This is fun, but I wish I had an ice cream...
entries.DesertFestival_Jodi: Oh, don't mind me, I'm just doing a little shopping.#$e#If I don't browse the shops, I might miss the perfect decoration for our living room!
entries.DesertFestival_Leah: I was just wondering... If I lived here, instead of Stardew Valley, would my art look different?
entries.DesertFestival_Leah_marriage: I wanted to go swimming, but apparently the water's full of scorpion carp!$h
entries.DesertFestival_Leo: I like this place. The weather reminds me of home.
entries.DesertFestival_Lewis: After a long, dark winter, this festival is a good way to revive everyone.
entries.DesertFestival_Lewis2: All of this is possible because you fixed the bus, @! I can't thank you enough.
entries.DesertFestival_Lewis3: Remember, today is the last day of the festival. We'll be back next year, though.
entries.DesertFestival_Linus: I hitched a ride underneath the bus.#$e#You can't find this Calico Desert flavor anywhere else. Heheh...$h
entries.DesertFestival_Marnie: Hey, @. I was just thinking about milk.#$e#Would you ever try camel's milk? I've heard it's salty.
entries.DesertFestival_Maru: I'm impressed with how well-trained these little racers are!$h
entries.DesertFestival_Maru_marriage: How's the Calico Egg collection coming along? There's so many cool prizes!$h#$e#I know you'll do great.
entries.DesertFestival_NowOpen: The Desert Festival is now open!
entries.DesertFestival_Pam: Hey, kid... You takin' the day off? It's nice to kick back every once in a while, isn't it?#$e#Yep... Even ol' Pam needs some sunlight on her skin now and then! Just wake me up before I turn into leather... Heheh.
entries.DesertFestival_Penny: Thousands of years ago, this place was the homeland of an ancient civilization. I wonder what they were like?
entries.DesertFestival_Penny_marriage: Hi, honey. I'm just browsing to see if there's anything nice for the house.$h
entries.DesertFestival_Pierre: As a shopkeeper, I find it interesting to see how other people run their shops.#$e#*whisper* Don't tell Sandy, but my grocery selection blows hers out of the water!
entries.DesertFestival_Robin: Hey @. We're just chewing the fat over here. I don't see these guys very often, even though we're neighbors!
entries.DesertFestival_Sam: Hey, @. Check out my cactus. I'm trying to think of a name for him.#$e#Hmm... maybe '%name'?
entries.DesertFestival_Sam_marriage: Hey, don't forget to pick up our free cactus before the festival ends.#$b#Whatever it looks like, it's gonna be perfect in our house!$h
entries.DesertFestival_Sandy: This is probably the busiest time of the year for me! It's nice to be able to see everyone.
entries.DesertFestival_Sebastian: Hey. I'm just hanging out with this bird. She seems to like me.
entries.DesertFestival_Sebastian_marriage: Hey, I'll just stay here and relax in the shade.#$e#You know how I am... I've always been more of a cave dweller.$h
entries.DesertFestival_Shane: I came here once when I was a kid... The only thing I remember is getting sick on the bus ride.
entries.DesertFestival_Shane_marriage: Remind me to brush my teeth tonight... there's twelve unique soda flavors, and I'm on track to try them all.#$e#Mmm... cave carrot soda... *slurp*
entries.DesertFestival_Willy: Ah, nothing like the smell o' grilled shrimp on a warm day.

entries.Fizz_Intro_1: So... you got my letter, huh? Nice to meet ya.#$b#I'm Fizz. Joja Special Services Division.$h#$b#You haven't heard of us? That's okay, most people haven't...#$b#We're not really advertised like other Joja products. We're more of a 'specialty service' for elite clients.#$b#What do we do? Heh... well, let's just say... we specialize in 'legally complex' matters... catch my drift?#$b#But enough chit chat. Let's get to business.#$b#I've heard you're trying to achieve 'perfection'. A noble goal! ... but difficult. Very difficult.#$b#All that cooking, crafting, monster slaying, all those complicated friendships... *groan*. I can see how stressed you are.$s#$b#But here's the thing... you don't need to stress another minute! We've got you covered.$h#$b#See these papers here? They're called 'perfection waivers'.#$b#Each one of these beautiful pages are worth 1% toward perfection. They've even got Mr. Qi's signature on it... completely legit!#$b#Do I look like someone who would lie to you??$u#$b#...$u#$b#Don't answer that.#$b#...Anyway, I'm selling these for a sweet, sweet price... just 500,000g a pop. A steal!#$b#Well, no pressure. Just think about it! I'll be waiting...$h
entries.Fizz_Intro_2: So... what do you say? 500,000g for a bonafide 'Perfection Waiver'?
